name: LIW Furniture
old_description: We are a family owned custom furniture company based in the heart of Lancaster County, Pa. Our experienced team specializes in modern, contemporary iron and hardwood furniture including tables, cabinets, office furniture and more. We love bringing your big ideas to life, whether you need tables and chairs for your business or restaurant, or you want to invest in a specialized dining set for your home.
about:
LIW Furniture operates from East Earl in Lancaster County, Pennsylvania. The family-owned business is led by Case Taylor, who brought hands-on experience from Amish Artisan Woodcraft into the venture. Taylor's background in cabinetry, millwork, and custom furniture shaped the company's focus on practical design and durable construction.

The shop produces custom hardwood and iron furniture — dining tables, chairs, cabinets, office pieces, and specialty items — all hand crafted on site. Materials are sourced from native Appalachian forests, giving the team control over lumber selection through local partnerships. Customers choose from a catalogue of solid-wood designs or collaborate with in-house designers and craftsmen to specify finishes, hardware, and live-edge tops with custom bases.

LIW serves both residential and commercial clients. Restaurants, retail spaces, and offices have commissioned dining sets, built-ins, vanities, and bar installations; a restaurant project for John Harris is cited as a reference. The company also works with homeowners on dining-room collections and one-off pieces.

The company emphasizes that it never sacrifices quality for quantity, maintaining oversight from raw lumber to final finish. Its differentiators include locally sourced hardwoods, hand-crafted construction in a Lancaster wood shop, and a design process that lets customers tailor stains, paints, metal features, and live-edge details to exact specifications.
